title: The Altar of Burnt Offering
description: God gives Moses detailed instructions for making the altar of burnt offering from acacia wood overlaid with bronze. The altar is to be square, five cubits long and wide, and three cubits high, with horns on its four corners. It must also include buckets, shovels, basins, meat forks, and fire pans made of bronze, as well as a bronze grate with rings and carrying poles of acacia wood overlaid with bronze.
